title: Area-code shard C pass 30 — 785 / 803 / 806

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public professional actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 785, 803, and 806?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public professional-role enumeration, seed-family expansion, and explicit uncertainty handling. X and Reddit discovery did not depend on official APIs.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, membership, public role, or event participation.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.
For locality-derived NPA hits, geographic association does not imply a published phone number unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: Lawrence Food Not Bombs is current through 2026 local-library and ECM host/collaborator evidence. ECM is retained as its current host/collaborator and directly publishes a 785 phone number. Jessie Duke is retained only for the directly stated ECM Executive Director role.

Columbia Food Not Bombs is current, shares food weekly in Finlay Park, and publishes two 803 contact numbers plus public Facebook identity. PITCH 803 is a current Columbia/Midlands food-access and community-fridge organization. Kristie Jordan is retained only for the directly stated PITCH Executive Director role.

Lubbock DSA is current and explicitly democratic socialist/nonviolent rather than relabeled anarchist. East Lubbock Art House is current and operates mutual-aid/community-fridge programming with several public social endpoints. Danielle Demetria East is retained only for the directly stated founder role.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-professional-role enumeration pass

summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public professional-role enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 785, 803, and 806.
